name: Uptime Dedicated Server
author: rubyrack@users.noreply.github.com
description: Uptime dedicated server on the official image. Installed from Steam (app 5053430) with anonymous SteamCMD. The primary allocation is the UDP query port.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

[[ "$(uname -m)" == "x86_64" ]] || { echo "x86_64 only; this node is $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1; }

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl tar lib32gcc-s1 lib32stdc++6

mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/worlds /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
if [[ ! -x ./steamcmd.sh ]]; then
    curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 \
        https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz \
        -o /tmp/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
    tar -xzf /tmp/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
fi

./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous \
    +app_update 1007 validate \
    +app_update 5053430 validate \
    +quit || true

[[ -s /mnt/server/uptime-server && -s /mnt/server/start_server.sh ]] || {
    echo "download failed: uptime-server or start_server.sh missing" >&2
    exit 1
}
chmod +x /mnt/server/uptime-server /mnt/server/start_server.sh

for candidate in /mnt/server/linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so; do
    if [[ -s "$candidate" ]]; then
        cp -- "$candidate" /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so
        break
    fi
done
[[ -s /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so ]] || { echo "steamclient.so not found" >&2; exit 1; }

for f in adminlist.txt bannedlist.txt permittedlist.txt; do
    [[ -e "/mnt/server/worlds/$f" ]] || : > "/mnt/server/worlds/$f"
done

echo "installed"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Shown in server lists. Must not contain the password.

variables.name: World File
variables.description: Path below worlds/. Loaded when it exists, created from the scenario when it does not.

variables.name: Scenario
variables.description: Used only when the world file is created. ./uptime-server --list-scenarios prints the ids.

variables.name: Sandbox Site
variables.description: Sandbox only: --site garage, --site basement, --site small_colo or --site small_campus. Applies when the world is created.

variables.name: Steam Game-Server Port
variables.description: UDP, internal. Needs no allocation; must differ from the query port.

variables.name: Advertised Address
variables.description: --public-addr IP:PORT when players reach the server at a different address or port than the node's. IPv4 only.

variables.name: Public Listing
variables.description: --public to list the server in the game's Internet tab.

variables.name: Hard Mode
variables.description: --hard to create a new world in hard mode. Existing worlds keep their mode.

variables.name: Extra Arguments
variables.description: Appended last. Example: --seed 12345. Do not pass --bind, --port, --host-token or --http-port.

variables.name: Update On Start
variables.description: 1 checks Steam for a new server build before every start.
